Game Overview

At its heart, Going up is a animal game about guide a lone bird through a pixelated world in "Going Up." With simple tap-to-fly controls, dodge obstacles, collect coins, and unlock new skins. Timing is essential in this nostalgic and challenging arcade adventure that balances simplicity with addictive fun. Will your skills carry the bird home?
